source_prompt: Surreal desert landscape under a swirling green and blue aurora borealis filled with ghostly faces and spiral patterns. A bright green dog wearing a purple patterned bandana stands on a giant rusty film reel. The reel is unspooling old film strips with tiny scenes. In the foreground, a happy blue mushroom character and a small yellow mushroom stand in a reflective puddle. Scattered film canisters, newspapers and debris cover the cracked ground. Distant mountains and a utility pole visible. Psychedelic, detailed, painterly style.
